**Legal compliance cannot be determined from this evidence alone.**

No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 hectares or more was detected on the property between 2021 and 2025. The data did identify 0.4 hectares of loss in smaller patches in 2021, and recorded larger loss events before the 2020 baseline.

The satellite assessment does not establish whether those changes were lawful or whether the property meets any applicable forest regulations. A compliance determination would require the relevant legal requirements and property records, including any permits.
